name: 43232-longcontext-30b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), compute capability 9.0.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; the whole model on one card.
architecture: FP8 mixture-of-experts decoder (Qwen3MoeForCausalLM): 48 layers, hidden 2048, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 128 experts with 8 active per token, bfloat16 compute. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, bounded at 128 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, warmup 12.5%, no cooldown. Expect several minutes of traffic plus several minutes of weight load.
workload: Synthetic, 128 requests, every prompt exactly 32000 tokens and every generation exactly 500 tokens, sampled at temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0 with ignore_eos and request_format plain. Seed 43232 is pinned so the prompt set is reproducible.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing 32,000-token reports for eight concurrent users on a single 30-billion-parameter expert model GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for 43232-longcontext-30b-1gpu, passed straight to AsyncEngineArgs
# (`-` becomes `_`) for the engine pinned by `commit_id` in setupcard.md.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
attention-backend: FLASHINFER
kv-cache-dtype: fp8
max-model-len: 32768
max-num-seqs: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
enable-prefix-caching: true
dtype: bfloat16
